name: io.github.DocSlicer/docslicer
title: DocSlicer
description: Answer questions from documents too large to fit in context, reading only the sections you need.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSLICER_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Restrict file sources and outputs to this directory tree. Several may be given, separated by the platform path separator.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSLICER_MCP_ALLOW_CLAUDE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to refuse documents dropped into a Claude chat, which the app copies into its own directory outside DOCSLICER_MCP_ROOT.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSLICER_MCP_ALLOW_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to reject http(s) sources and only permit local files.
